card.name: History, fossils and museum text
card.fires_on: Words inside general-web passages about history, archaeology, fossils, museums or past events, often a small linking word like "of" or a partway-through name piece. It fires where the text is about the past.

modes.label: Linking words in past-themed phrases
modes.description: Small words such as "of", "a", "the" in phrases about ancient or historical things.
modes.example: They provide vivid examples<< of>> the massive size and careful construction methods used

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Inside historical or science names split into pieces, like Carver or Chawla.

modes.label: Past-related adjectives
modes.description: Words like lost, past, early in fossil or memorial contexts.
modes.example: What fossils tell us about<< past>> life and environments.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning "at that time" or "historical", so it seems to hold back past-time framing words.
